short_description: Outlook cannot connect to Exchange mailbox after hybrid migration with error 0x8004010F
description: User mock-alex.rivera@synthetic-test.local reported that Outlook desktop app fails to connect to mailbox following the weekend Exchange Online migration. The error dialogue displays: 'The operation failed. An object cannot be found. Error 0x8004010F'. Webmail (Outlook on the Web) works correctly.
work_notes:
2026-11-02 09:14 - Tech Kevin: Contacted user via Teams. Confirmed OWA is functional. Tested Autodiscover endpoint using Test E-mail AutoConfiguration in Outlook tray icon. Autodiscover is attempting to pull legacy on-premises Exchange 2016 Autodiscover.xml instead of autodiscover-s.outlook.com.
2026-11-02 09:35 - Tech Kevin: Checked Windows Credential Manager. Found cached legacy credentials under Generic Credentials for MS.Outlook.15:alex.rivera@synthetic-test.local. Removed stale credentials.
2026-11-02 09:50 - Tech Kevin: Outlook profile was still binding to legacy Offline Address Book (OAB) URL. Closed Outlook. Navigated to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Outlook\Offline Address Books and removed existing OAB folders. Recreated mail profile via Control Panel > Mail (Microsoft Outlook) > Show Profiles > Add 'Outlook_Modern'.
close_notes: Created new Outlook profile 'Outlook_Modern' configured with Modern Authentication. Outlook connected directly to Exchange Online via Autodiscover. All mail folders synchronized successfully. Error 0x8004010F resolved.
